modules.name: 探索主模型
modules.role: Use visitation memory and persistent subgoals; choose new regions and feasible desired directions after edge contact.
modules.limitation: The direction gate does not constrain the wheel trajectory during a turn. This is a validation-selected baseline, not a global optimum.

modules.name: 触黑框后的定位停车控制器
modules.kind: geometric feedback controller, not separate neural weights
modules.role: Fit early when observations suffice, verify direction stripes, scan laterally only when ambiguous, then park and verify settling.
modules.limitation: The 19.91-second local metric and the main model's search metric come from different experiments; do not add them as a measured end-to-end score.

modules.name: 触边运动小模型
inputs: desired heading/subgoal selected by main policy
modules.outputs: left/right wheel commands or a short retreat/turn/arc action
modules.role: Execute the chosen direction after edge contact; reduce wheel and centre excursion while recovering promptly.
modules.constraints: Freeze the retained exploration and parking modules; no simulator truth as inference inputs; no training or hardware upload during this cleanup.
modules.evaluation: Compare identical contact states and wheel velocities against the current executor, then check paired search completion and parking success.
